data.name: Actions.SetBrightness.Name
data.value: Set Stream Deck brightness

data.name: Actions.SetBrightness.Description
data.value: Sets the display brightness of every connected Stream Deck.

data.name: Actions.SetBrightness.Brightness.Label
data.value: Brightness

data.name: Actions.SetBrightness.Brightness.Description
data.value: Brightness in percent, from 0 to 100.

data.name: Actions.SetBrightness.InvalidBrightness
data.value: The brightness must be a number from 0 to 100.

data.name: Actions.SetBrightness.NoDevice
data.value: No Stream Deck with displays is connected.

data.name: Actions.SetBrightness.Failed
data.value: The Stream Deck did not accept the brightness.

data.name: Actions.WriteDiagnostics.Name
data.value: Write Stream Deck diagnostics to the log

data.name: Actions.WriteDiagnostics.Description
data.value: Writes a snapshot of every Stream Deck this plugin sees to the Macro Deck log. Attach it when you report a problem. Serial numbers are masked.

data.name: Actions.WriteDiagnostics.Trace.Label
data.value: Trace raw USB reports

data.name: Actions.WriteDiagnostics.Trace.Description
data.value: Keeps logging raw USB reports until this action runs again with the option off. Key pictures are never logged, only their size.

data.name: Issues.WriteDiagnostics
data.value: Write diagnostics to the log

data.name: Issues.DiagnosticsWritten
data.value: The diagnostics are in the Macro Deck log. Please attach them to your issue.

data.name: Issues.NothingToDo
data.value: There is nothing this plugin can do about this issue on its own.

data.name: Issues.HidUnavailable.Title
data.value: USB access is not available

data.name: Issues.HidUnavailable.Description
data.value: The plugin cannot look for Stream Decks: {error}

data.name: Issues.HostTooOld.Title
data.value: This Macro Deck version cannot draw Stream Deck keys

data.name: Issues.HostTooOld.Description
data.value: The Stream Deck is connected and its keys work, but the displays stay dark because this Macro Deck version does not render key images. Update Macro Deck.

data.name: Issues.OpenFailed.Title
data.value: {model} could not be opened

data.name: Issues.OpenFailed.Description
data.value: The device is attached but the plugin cannot open it: {error}. On Linux this usually means the udev rule from the plugin's README is missing. Another program that holds the device can also cause it.

data.name: Issues.Unsupported.Title
data.value: Unsupported Stream Deck

data.name: Issues.Unsupported.Description
data.value: {product} (vendor {vendorId}, product {productId}) is not supported yet and is ignored. Please open an issue for it and attach the diagnostics from the log.

data.name: Issues.Untested.Title
data.value: {model} is untested

data.name: Issues.Untested.Description
data.value: This model is supported from its protocol documentation only and was never tested on real hardware. If something does not work, please open an issue and attach the diagnostics from the log.
